description: The legacy Anyscale Endpoints hosted-model API is no longer operational. Anyscale now supports OpenAI-compatible inference through Anyscale Services: customers deploy and operate their own Ray Serve and vLLM applications on Anyscale-managed infrastructure, receiving a deployment-specific service URL rather than using a shared public inference base URL.
